notes: Sepolia ETH/ICE pool: currency0 is native ETH and currency1 is PepeIce. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, equal to 1000 * 2^96, representing 1,000,000 ICE per ETH. Sources: src/PepeIce.sol and src/JackpotHook.sol. PepeIce has a zero-argument constructor; JackpotHook takes only IPoolManager at the literal address in constructorArgs. getHookPermissions enables only beforeSwap and beforeSwapReturnDelta; all other flags are false. The constructor validates permission bits 0x0088 under mask 0x3fff, which the CREATE2 address must match. Pool initialization needs no hook callback. The hook validates native/ERC20 pool keys using itself, without restricting them to the canonical ICE address, fee or tick spacing. For A = abs(amountSpecified), F = floor(A / 100) is retained in the specified currency as per-pool ERC-6909 claims. beforeSwap executes an internal manager swap: exact input trades A-F, while exact output requests A+F. It rejects partial fills and returns deltas that offset the outer swap and forward the actual AMM result, leaving the trader's specified amount at A. Each eligible trade issues one ticket; indexers must account for both the internal and outer manager Swap events. A fee of at least 0.00001 ETH or 1 ICE issues a ticket; smaller fees still accrue to the pot without a ticket. The player is ABI-decoded from hookData when its length is 32 bytes, otherwise tx.origin. Anyone may draw once, with payment always to the recorded player. For ticket block B, draws use keccak256(abi.encode(blockhash(B+1), poolId, ticketId)) modulo 100 plus 1 during B+2 through B+256; earlier draws revert and later draws expire without payment. Roll 77 pays floor(90% of each current pot); rolls 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 pay min(20 * ticket.fee, floor(10% of the current fee-currency pot)). Other rolls pay nothing. Payouts burn claims and take assets through the manager's unlock callback. fillTank accepts 1-1000 pees and transfers exactly 10 ICE per pee from the caller to PoolManager, minting claims into the initialized pool's ICE pot; it creates no ticket or on-chain pee balance. No administrative controls or upgrades. Future-block-hash randomness is manipulable; a mainnet version needs Chainlink VRF. ABIs: docs/abi/PepeIce.json and docs/abi/JackpotHook.json.
